INTERVENOR SWG BRIGGS I, L.P.’S PROPOSED CORRECTION TO SOAH ORDER
                                 NO. 30

        SWG Briggs I, L.P. submits this Proposed Correction to SOAH Order No. 30 and would

show the following:

   I.      Correction to Attachment A information for SWG Briggs I, L.P (No. 343)

        SWG Briggs I, L.P. (Intervenor No. 343) respectfully requests that the Administrative Law

Judges correct the “Exhibits” cell in Attachment A of SOAH Order No. 30 as shown below:

        Party No.          Party Alignment              Witness                 Exhibits

          343              SWG Briggs I, L.P.      Amy G. Thomason           Ex. 1 through 5


SWG Briggs I, L.P. submitted Exhibits 1-5 through its timely filing of its Exhibit List (see Item

No. 5423) and timely uploaded the exhibits to Kiteworks and Egnyte. SOAH Order No. 30 lists

only Exhibits 1-4; however, Exhibit 5 was also included and attached to the Direct Testimony of

Dr. Amy G. Thomason on behalf of SWG Briggs I, L.P., which was timely filed on May 13, 2026

(see Item No. 3976). No party filed an objection to Dr. Thomason’s testimony.
